specification.name: NCTD Manifest Parser

extends.rule: All v2.8.0 rules remain active. This version removes nicknames from Client Name, moves them to Booking Notes and records the CBLA tag decision.

specification.description: v2.8.1 overlay: nicknames in Client Name, written between ( ), [ ] or double quotes, are removed together with their delimiters and kept in Booking Notes, to avoid aliases in TOBI.

changes: Added CLIENT-NAME-NICKNAME-001: a nickname between ( ), [ ], " " or “ ” in Client Name is removed with its delimiters (MATTHEWS,SCOTT  (MICHAEL) -> MATTHEWS / SCOTT), because TOBI uses the name as a key and a nickname creates aliases (decision 2026-11-15).
The removed nickname is appended to Booking Notes as "Nickname: MICHAEL", after any other Booking Notes content.
SOURCE-SPECIAL-CHARS-001 no longer applies to Client Name; it still removes ( ) [ ] from PUAddress, PUCity, PUZipcode, DOAddress, DOCity and DOZipcode, keeping the text.
Recorded: the CBLA tag stays in Tobi Tags with its five detection phrases, including CBLA and CAN NOT BE LEFT ALONE (decision 2026-11-15).
The passenger catalog is regenerated from the 2026-10-23 manifest with these rules (decision 2026-11-15).
Added acceptance tests AT-59 to AT-62.

source_character_cleanup.client_name: Not applied to Client Name since v2.8.1; see field_rules.client_name.nickname_removal (CLIENT-NAME-NICKNAME-001).

nickname_removal.action: Remove each nickname together with its delimiters, then collapse repeated spaces and trim.
nickname_removal.unmatched_delimiters: A delimiter without its pair is removed; the text next to it is kept.
nickname_removal.not_delimiters: Single quotes and apostrophes are not touched (O'BRIEN).
nickname_removal.applies_before: validate_required_fields: CLIENT-NAME-FORMAT-001 checks the name without the nickname, so DOE,(JANE) goes to Invalid Trips.

booking_note.position: Appended after the other Booking Notes content (Comments, Lift Required), joined with the Booking Notes delimiter.

nickname_removal.invalid_trips: Invalid Trips keeps the original Client Name, nickname included.
nickname_removal.passenger_catalog: Not applied to an uploaded catalog; the catalog is regenerated from the 2026-10-23 manifest (decision 2026-11-15).
nickname_removal.reason: TOBI uses the passenger name as a key; a nickname in the name creates aliases.

tobi_tags.decision_2026_11_15: The CBLA tag stays in Tobi Tags. Detection phrases: CANNOT BE LEFT ALONE, CAN NOT BE LEFT ALONE, CBLA, DO NOT LEAVE ALONE, DO NOT LEAVE UNATTENDED.

acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Removed from the name with its delimiters; Booking Notes gets Nickname: <nickname>

acceptance_tests_patch.case: Comments and Space Type LR already fill Booking Notes

acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Invalid Trips with INVALID_CLIENT_NAME_FORMAT; Invalid Trips keeps the original name

consistency_contract_patch.acceptance_test_id_range: AT-01..AT-62 with no gaps after applying v2.5.0 to v2.8.1
